headline: Marginal SSE mush today — small and cross-textured.
today: Under 2ft on a marginal angle with cross-off wind that isn't quite enough to make it fun. Nothing worth prioritizing here. If you paddle out it's a longboard and low expectations.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE angle at 9s but tiny — cross-off dawn is clean and loggable early before the afternoon onshore fills in.
Best of the week: 3-plus feet with W offshore into the afternoon. Short period and marginal angle temper it, but clean wind and real size make it the session to catch.
Small but a good SE angle at 8s with offshore dawn — worth a quick clean longboard check early.
